paragraphs: Construction workers can get career support and help finding open positions in construction.

CityBuild's Employment Network Services (ENS) connects qualified construction workers with contractors and job opportunities. Construction workers certified through ENS get added to CityBuild's database of local workers and can get referrals to open construction positions and projects. To get certified, follow the steps below. Learn more about CityBuild .

sections.heading: Check if you're eligible
paragraphs: Services are only open to construction workers who live in San Francisco. You must have:
Union Affiliation and be current on dues

sections.heading: Contact an Employment Liaison
paragraphs: Call 415-701-4817 or email citybuild@sfgov.org to speak with an employment liaison who will guide you through the services offered by Employment Network Services and explain the steps to get certified.

sections.heading: Get help when you are looking for work
paragraphs: Contact your employment liaison when you are looking for work and we will place you in our database and trades list for employers looking to fill open positions.
